fields.name: Grimhilde
fields.description: Leathery, slipping skin. Twitchy and unsettling. Very long fingernails.
fields.unique_thing: I am the last remnant of an ancient necromantic culture, dug out of a bog and displayed for years in a museum.
fields.talents:
Redeemer - Summoned undead are released from service > fight harder for you. Minions: On death release CHA * 1d4 holy burst to all engaged, atks deal +CHA holy dmg.

Cackling Soliloquist - Spend all actions casting a /arc spell, spell recharges 18+ after battle + invent a slight improvement to spell.

Death Priest - Icon connections can be conversations with the dead. Also can use Seance 1/arc when not in battle.
fields.gear_notes:
Flap of demonic neck skin
Rusty nail

backgrounds.name: Displayed in a museum for years

powers.name: Seance
powers.desc: Short rite to contact dead related to random non-Lich Queen icon. GM rolls in secret, on 1-2 info is wrong

powers.name: Cackling Soliloquist
powers.desc:
Spend all actions when casting a /arc spell, spell recharges 18+ after battle + invent a slight improvement to spell.
ADV FEAT: Also gain 1d6 + LVL + CHA temp HP.

spells.name: Chant of Endings
spells.desc:
Target: The nearby enemy with the fewest hit points (you choose if there’s a tie; you also don’t have to be able to see that enemy)
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD (+5)
Hit: 1d10 + Intelligence necro damage.

spells.name: Command Undead
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby undead creature with 64 hp or fewer
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target is confused (hard save ends, 16+).
ADV FEAT: Miss does not expend spell

spells.name: Unholy Blast
spells.desc:
Target: One nearby enemy
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. PD
Hit: 4d6 + Intelligence negative energy damage.
First Miss: Half damage, and make the attack again against an
enemy you haven’t already targeted with unholy blast this turn.
Second Miss: Half damage, or full damage if the escalation die is
1+ and you choose to decrease it by 1.

spells.name: Summon Undead
spells.desc:
Effect: You summon a mob of 1d3 + 1 crumbling skeleton mooks, as per the summoning rules on page 11. These skeletons fight for you until the end of the battle or until they drop to 0 hp, whichever comes first.

1st level mook [undead]
Initiative: +6 Vulnerability: holy
Sword +6 vs. AC—3 damage+CHA (First attack extra +CHA (3) vs AC)
Resist weapons 16+: When a weapon attack targets this creature, the attacker must roll a natural 16+ on the attack roll or it only deals half damage.
AC 16, PD 14, MD 10, HP 6 (mook)
Mook: Kill one crumbling skeleton mook for every 6 damage you deal to the mob.

spells.name: Terror
spells.desc:
One nearby enemy <= 50hp
Attack: Intelligence + Level vs. MD
Hit: The target uses all its actions during its turn to move away from the battle, disengaging from enemies to do so (hard save ends, 16+). If it fails to disengage with all of its actions, it won’t take opportunity attacks by moving. The effect also ends when you or one of your allies attacks the target.
Miss: 1d10 + Intelligence psychic damage
